description: Source code for handling animation delta calculations in the game Unvanquished, including loading delta animations, parsing configuration, and applying deltas to skeletons.

classes.name: AnimDelta
classes.description: Class responsible for managing animation delta data and applying it to character skeletons.

methods.name: AnimDelta::ParseConfiguration
methods.description: Parses configuration data for hand bones from a token stream.

methods.name: AnimDelta::LoadData
methods.description: Loads delta animation data for each weapon based on the character's model and animations.

methods.name: AnimDelta::Apply
methods.description: Applies the loaded delta animations to the current skeleton based on the character's state.
